#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    int balance[2] = {0, 0};

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            balance[0]++;
        } else {
            balance[1]++;
        }
        if (balance[0] == balance[1]) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int sum = 0;
    int answer = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        sum += cost;
        if (sum > B) {
            break;
        }
        answer++;
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
